title: Organisation profile
description: Facts about one organisation that the toolkit needs but cannot choose: platforms, tools already in place, and who fills each engagement role. Kept in the organisation's private organisation repo as organisation-profile.yaml, never in this repo. Facts with no choice go here; choices go in the organisation repo's own decision records.

toolkit.description: Which toolkit release this organisation builds on. Its artifacts arrive through the organisation's package repository; nothing is fetched from public code-hosting sites.

version.description: Toolkit release, e.g. 1.4.0. Change it by pull request to upgrade.

group_id.description: Maven group of the toolkit's artifacts.

source_mirror.description: Optional: address of the organisation's internal copy of the toolkit source, for people to browse.

organisation_repo.description: Where this profile and the organisation's own decision records live.

repo_count_estimate.description: Rough number of repositories in scope; sizes the measurement budget.

issue_tracker.description: Where the programme backlog and each repo's work items are kept.

project_key.description: Project or board identifier, where the tracker has one.

runs_on.description: What build jobs run on. Kubernetes-based platforms usually have no Docker daemon.

image_build_tool.description: e.g. docker, buildah, kaniko. Builds images; does not run the containers tests need.

note.description: e.g. why there is no runtime and whether that may change.

allowed.description: AI assistants people may use with this toolkit.

independent_agents_allowed.description: Whether AI agents may work unattended. False until approved, vetted and tested.

deployment_records.description: Where to find which repos are deployed (a deployment tool or release records).

secrets_scanning.description: Secret-scanning tool already in use, if any.

tools.description: Where the tools the skills run are kept inside the organisation, when not on each machine's path.

connection_paths_jar.description: Path or URL of the mirrored connection-paths jar, which the draft-the-external-systems-list skill runs.

under_test_tools_jar.description: Path or URL of the mirrored under-test-tools jar, which runs the mechanical steps of skills such as find-meaningless-and-unreliable-tests.

maven.description: The Maven command to use where a repo has no Maven wrapper, such as mvn or a path to it.

gradle.description: The Gradle command to use where a repo has no Gradle wrapper; old builds may need an old Gradle.

production_hosts.description: Source of the list of production host names (DNS zones, configuration database, naming rule).

roles.description: Who fills each engagement role: a person, or a team on the code-hosting platform used for review rules.

product.description: The organisation's feature flag product, if any.

openfeature_provider.description: Coordinates of the OpenFeature provider for that product.

commit_messages.description: Whether every commit must name a work item in the issue tracker. When true, AI assistant skills include the key, and the commit-message checks are switched on.

work_item_key_pattern.description: Regular expression a key matches, e.g. [A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+ for Jira keys.
